transaction.sql: SELECT transaction_timestamp() AS at, current_database() AS database, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation, pg_database_size(current_database()) AS database_bytes

connections.sql: SELECT datname, application_name, state, count(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY datname,application_name,state ORDER BY datname,application_name,state

relations.sql: SELECT c.relname AS name, pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_bytes, pg_table_size(c.oid) AS table_bytes, pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS index_bytes, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind='r' ORDER BY c.relname

columns.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

foreign_keys.sql: SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS child, conname AS name, confrelid::regclass::text AS parent, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND connamespace='public'::regnamespace ORDER BY child,name

rows.name: fk_articles_current_material
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_material_id) REFERENCES content_materials(article_id, id)

rows.name: fk_content_derivation_material
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (article_id, material_id) REFERENCES content_materials(article_id, id)

rows.name: event_viewpoints_event_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

article_tracks.sql: SELECT processing_track,count(*) AS rows, sum(octet_length(coalesce(content,''))) AS content_bytes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL) AS event_linked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE canonical_content_id IS NOT NULL) AS aliases, count(*) FILTER (WHERE current_material_id IS NOT NULL) AS current_material, min(fetched_at) AS first_at,max(fetched_at) AS last_at FROM articles GROUP BY processing_track ORDER BY processing_track

materials.sql: SELECT scope,access_status,count(*) AS rows, sum(pg_column_size(m)) AS logical_row_bytes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.current_material_id=m.id) AS current_pointers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_derivations d WHERE d.material_id=m.id AND d.article_id=m.article_id)) AS derived, min(retrieved_at) AS first_at,max(retrieved_at) AS last_at FROM content_materials m JOIN articles a ON a.id=m.article_id GROUP BY scope,access_status ORDER BY scope,access_status

material_candidates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS noncurrent_without_derivation, coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(m)),0) AS logical_row_bytes FROM content_materials m JOIN articles a ON a.id=m.article_id WHERE a.current_material_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_derivations d WHERE d.material_id=m.id AND d.article_id=m.article_id)

material_duplicates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS fingerprint_groups, coalesce(sum(n-1),0) AS extra_rows FROM (SELECT text_fingerprint,count(*) AS n FROM content_materials WHERE text_fingerprint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY text_fingerprint HAVING count(*)>1) d

content_derivations_groups.sql: SELECT kind,status,count(*) AS rows, min(updated_at) AS first_at,max(updated_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM content_derivations GROUP BY kind,status ORDER BY kind,status

pipeline_tasks_groups.sql: SELECT queue,kind,status,count(*) AS rows, min(created_at) AS first_at,max(created_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM pipeline_tasks GROUP BY queue,kind,status ORDER BY queue,kind,status

task_attempts_groups.sql: SELECT status,count(*) AS rows, min(started_at) AS first_at,max(started_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM task_attempts GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

content_observations_groups.sql: SELECT source_id,count(*) AS rows, min(observed_at) AS first_at,max(observed_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE observed_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM content_observations GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id

discovery_batches_groups.sql: SELECT source_id,version,count(*) AS rows, min(observed_at) AS first_at,max(observed_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE observed_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM discovery_batches GROUP BY source_id,version ORDER BY source_id,version

fetch_logs_groups.sql: SELECT status,count(*) AS rows, min(run_at) AS first_at,max(run_at) AS last_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE run_at >= transaction_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AS last_24h_rows FROM fetch_logs GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

source_owners.sql: SELECT owner,enabled,count(*) AS rows FROM source_states GROUP BY owner,enabled ORDER BY owner,enabled

quota_references.sql: SELECT count(*) AS tasks_with_quota_batch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM discovery_batches b WHERE b.id::text=t.payload->>'quota_batch_id')) AS matched FROM pipeline_tasks t WHERE payload ? 'quota_batch_id'

quota_receipt_keys.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT (source_id,cycle_key)) AS unique_keys FROM discovery_batches

request_groups.sql: SELECT stage,status,count(*) AS rows, sum(reserved_usd) AS reserved_usd, sum(u.cost_usd::numeric) AS known_usd, count(task_id) AS task_links,count(article_id) AS article_links FROM billed_requests b LEFT JOIN llm_usage u ON u.id=b.usage_id GROUP BY stage,status ORDER BY stage,status

unresolved_requests.sql: SELECT id,status,stage,article_id,task_id,task_attempt_id, provider_generation_id,reserved_usd,started_at,ended_at,http_status FROM billed_requests WHERE status IN ('reserved','usage_unknown') ORDER BY id

known_usage.sql: SELECT purpose,count(*) AS rows,sum(cost_usd::numeric) AS usd FROM llm_usage GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose

legacy_runs.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,min(run_at) AS first_at,max(run_at) AS last_at FROM pipeline_runs

digest_range.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,min(report_date) AS first_date,max(report_date) AS last_date FROM digests
